description: Create the S7-owned Vignette browser adapter packages/captions/src/preview/vignette-full-page.ts that renders the integrated VignetteScene (real teacher, classroom@1.2.0 doorway, hinged door@1.1.0, S5 action tracks, S3 face tracks) with the runVignette-solved ShotChoice cameras, then composites the full S7 layer stack (VFX particles/post/shake/zoom, emote billboards, world_text_3d, ui_popup, title_card, caption_bold placed clear of ALL projected faces including the teacher). It exposes the SAME window API surface the render tool drives (ready/init/place/initCapture/encodeRange/meta) so render-full.ts can capture deterministic H.264 frames from it exactly as it does from stills-page.ts. This is purely the browser-side module plus any diagnostic hooks it must expose for the pixel/geometry/performance gates; wiring it into render-full.ts is FEAT-003. Depends on FEAT-001 (deps + Chromium so typecheck and any in-page smoke can run).
steps: STUDY three files before writing: packages/captions/src/preview/stills-page.ts (the existing window.__s7 API: init(ep,lib,sb,itl,w,h), place(captions,graphics) returning per-caption shot-segment placements clear of faces, initCapture(cfg), encodeRange(from,to,final), meta(); plus drawFrame, occupied()/project()/corners(), FrameCapture usage, drawOverlay caption compositing, EmoteLayer/WorldTextLayer/evalVfxEvents/applyZoom/applyShake usage); packages/vignette/src/web-entry.ts (how VignetteScene is rendered in-browser with a solved ShotChoice: beatAt(plan,t), poseAt(shot,beat.start,t), scene.vfx(f) for shake/post/particles, applyShake({pos,target,fovY,roll},...), renderer.render(scene.root, cam, scene.lighting(f), fx.post, fx.particles), drawVignetteOverlay); packages/vignette/src/scene.ts (VignetteScene: pose(t) returns PosedFrame, rigs Map, props Map incl. teacher rig and door leaves, entityPoint for anchors, actorsRoot/propsRoot).

Create packages/captions/src/preview/vignette-full-page.ts exposing window.__s7v (a distinct global from stills-page's __s7 to avoid collision) with: ready:true; init(sheet, lib, shots, w, h) that calls registerRuntimeLibrary(lib) (already called inside runVignette on the node side, but the browser page re-stages, so call it here too), validates+stages the sheet exactly as web-entry does (validateBeatSheet -> stageBeatSheet -> new VignetteScene(plan, lib)) so the in-page plan is byte-identical to the node-solved plan (same beat sheet + seed => deterministic), stores the passed solved `shots` (Record<phraseId,ShotChoice>) from runVignette, creates the gl canvas + Renderer(w,h) + 2D composite canvas, and adds EmoteLayer + WorldTextLayer roots to scene.root. Use packages/engine/src/production-independent primitives already imported by web-entry/stills; do NOT construct NarratedScene or call buildWorldPlan.

Implement a camera function pose(t): const b = beatAt(plan,t); const shot = shots[b.phraseId]; const p = poseAt(shot, b.start, t); combine with S7 zoom+shake: first scene VFX shake from scene.vfx(f) as web-entry does, then the S7 vfx event zoom/shake via evalVfxEvents+applyZoom+applyShake exactly like stills-page.drawFrame. Return the CameraState the renderer expects (pos, target, fovY=p.fovDeg*PI/180, roll). Keep it deterministic and random-access safe: scene.pose(t) is a pure function of t (per scene.ts docstring), so any frame index can be drawn in any order.

Implement drawFrame(f) mirroring stills-page: scene.pose(f.t); compute cam via pose(t) with f.vfx; update emotes.update(vf.emotes, id=>rig headTop worldPos via scene rigs, cam) and worldText.update(f.graphics,...) using scene.entityPoint for anchors; add button-glow / vfx point lights onto scene.lighting(f) result; renderer.render(scene.root, cam, lighting, vf.post, [...scene.vfx(f).particles, ...vf.particles]); draw the gl canvas onto the 2D composite; compute projected face rects for ALL rigs currently visible (Zapp, Kira, AND teacher) via project(cam, head-mesh corners); call drawOverlay(g, W, H, t, {captions, placements, graphics, anchor}) to composite ui_popup/title_card/caption_bold clear of faces; return the face rects.

Hide staging placeholder labels when the real S7 implementation renders that effect: since we use the approved beat sheet with all-available assets, VignetteScene should already resolve real teacher/door/actions (no placeholders). Still, guard: when an S7 VFX/emote/text is being drawn by this adapter for a target, set the corresponding scene event-label node.visible=false for that window (the scene exposes eventLabels via its own visibility logic; ensure our S7 overlay path suppresses the grey 3D placeholder labels for vfx/text that we render for real — e.g. skip drawing scene event labels whose id is covered by an S7 vfx/graphic event we handle). Do not render both a placeholder and the real effect.

Reproduce the caption placement API: place(captions, graphics) that, per caption, segments by camera cuts (shot boundaries from the solved shots timeline: a caption stays in one band within a shot and may re-band only at a hard cut), samples every output frame in each segment, collects occupied face+body+prop rects (including the teacher's face), and returns { segments, centerY, clearOfFaces, faceOverlapPx, warnings } per caption id — same shape stills-page.place returns so render-full's conflict check works unchanged. The shot cut times come from the solved ShotChoice per beat (each beat is one shot; if the redesign introduces multiple compositions per beat via sub-shots, expose those cut times too).

Reproduce the capture API used by render-full: initCapture(cfg:{fps,bitrate,hashEvery,keyframeInterval,vfx,graphics,captions,placements}) constructing a FrameCapture over the 2D composite exactly as stills-page does; encodeRange(from,to,final) => capture.encodeRange(from,to,(i)=>drawFrame({...plan,t:i/fps}),final); meta() => capture.meta. Keep codec 'avc1.640028', hashEvery default fps.

Add diagnostic hooks this adapter must expose for the FEAT-003 acceptance gates (so gates read real pixels/geometry, not asserted rig existence): (a) teacherVisibility(times[]) -> for each t, the projected screen-area fraction of the teacher rig (require it be from teacher@1.0.0, expose the source key) so p01 (~2.4/3.0/3.8s) and p13 (~60.3/60.8/61.5/62.5s) and p14 (~65.5-68.5s) can require meaningful projected area; (b) doorState(times[]) -> door@1.1.0 leaf/grip world transform + open amount + projected doorway rect so a closed-vs-open sample pair proves the leaf/grip moved and the doorway is on camera during a p01 and a p13 sample, and confirm there is no duplicate fallback doorway (scene builds doorOpening not doorFrame when the real door resolved); (c) jointSample(actorId, t) -> key joint/root world positions + face-track expression+blink state so performance gates can measure neck+torso (p02 look_around), arms/torso/root (p03 celebrate), alternating limbs/sway (p04 dance), neck+Kira strict face + Zapp translation toward button (p06), hand-to-button-contact-anchor (p07 press), Kira hand-to-face + Zapp celebrate (p08 facepalm), Kira posture transition (p10 stand_up), Kira root displacement to safe mark (p11 walk), Zapp prone/flattened + Kira recoil (p12), teacher root displacement through doorway (p13), teacher look target toward scene (p14). Confirm the narrator VO never flaps character mouths (FaceTrack drives faces, no PhraseMouth from beat text — already true in scene.ts; expose enough to assert mouth openness is not narration-driven).

Ensure the module builds under tsconfig.web.json (it is a browser page module like stills-page.ts and web-entry.ts). Do not import node-only modules. Reuse the same import sources as stills-page.ts and web-entry.ts.

Run `npm run typecheck` and fix any type errors introduced by the new module. Optionally add a tiny in-page smoke via the existing render harness or a minimal Playwright load to confirm window.__s7v.ready and init() succeed without pageerror, but the full render happens in FEAT-003.
acceptance_criteria: packages/captions/src/preview/vignette-full-page.ts exists, compiles under tsconfig.web.json, and exposes a window global with ready/init/place/initCapture/encodeRange/meta plus the teacherVisibility/doorState/jointSample diagnostic hooks.
The adapter renders VignetteScene via poseAt-solved cameras and scene.pose(t) (NOT NarratedScene/buildWorldPlan) and composites S7 VFX/emotes/world-text/ui_popup/title_card/caption_bold.
Caption placement is computed against projected faces of ALL visible rigs including the teacher, and returns the same per-caption segment shape render-full.ts expects.
npm run typecheck passes with the new module present.
No duplicate NarratedScene logic is added; the adapter does not fabricate a teacher/door.
verification: Run `npm run typecheck` and confirm it passes.
Run `node --test tests/vignette-runtime-integration.test.ts` and confirm still passing (the adapter must not break the vignette runtime).

Load the module in a headless Chromium page (via the existing browser harness or a minimal Playwright script) with the real beat sheet + library + a runVignette shots object and confirm window.__s7v.ready is true, init() returns without throwing, and no pageerror is emitted for at least a few sampled frames drawn out of order (determinism / random-access).

findings.module: packages/captions/src/preview/vignette-full-page.ts (committed on feature/competitor-performance-v2). Browser page module compiled to dist/packages/captions/src/preview/vignette-full-page.js by `npm run build`.
findings.window_global: window.__s7v (distinct from stills-page's window.__s7 so both modules coexist; render-full.ts in FEAT-003 loads whichever matches the visual mode).
findings.api_surface: ready:true; init(sheet, lib, shots, w, h) -> { renderer, beats, sets } (re-stages in-page: registerRuntimeLibrary(lib) -> validateBeatSheet -> stageBeatSheet -> new VignetteScene(plan,lib); stores solved shots; creates gl canvas + Renderer(w,h) + 2D `out` composite; adds EmoteLayer.root + WorldTextLayer.root to scene.root). place(captions, graphics) -> Record<id,{segments:[{start,end,centerY,clearOfFaces,faceOverlapPx,warnings}],centerY,clearOfFaces,faceOverlapPx,warnings}> (segments split at beat/shot boundaries; occupancy = every visible rig face+body incl. teacher + visible props + ui_popup graphics; SAME shape as stills-page.place). frame(f,quality) -> {url,faces}. initCapture(cfg{fps,bitrate,hashEvery,keyframeInterval,vfx,graphics,captions,placements}) -> true (FrameCapture over `out`, codec avc1.640028, hashEvery default=fps). encodeRange(from,to,final) -> Promise<EncodedBatch> (capture.encodeRange(...,(i)=>drawFrame({...capturePlan,t:i/fps}),final)). meta() -> EncoderMeta. emoteSheet() (showcase helper).
findings.camera_fusion: pose(t): beatAt(plan,t) -> shots[b.phraseId] -> poseAt(shot,b.start,t) lens, then applyShake(scene.vfx(f).shake) (web-entry), then applyZoom(applyShake(cam, s7vf.shake), s7vf.zoom) from evalVfxEvents (stills-page). Returns renderer CameraState {pos,target,fovY=fovDeg*PI/180,roll}. Pure of t / random-access safe (verified out-of-order draws are deterministic).
findings.drawFrame: scene.pose(t); render scene.root with fused cam, scene.lighting(f) + s7 vfx point lights, merged post (max of scene + s7 flash/darken/vignette), particles = [...scene.vfx(f).particles, ...s7 vf.particles]; emotes.update via rig.headTop.worldPos; worldText.update via scene.entityPoint; draw gl canvas to 2D composite; drawOverlay places ui_popup/title_card/caption_bold clear of projected faces of ALL visible rigs incl. teacher. First frame after init draws twice to warm program/geometry upload.

diagnostic_hooks.teacherVisibility(times[]): -> { sourceKey, source, samples:[{t,present,areaFrac,faceAreaFrac}] }. areaFrac = projected screen-area fraction of the whole teacher rig; faceAreaFrac = its head mesh. sourceKey read from scene.sources['character:teacher'] (verified 'teacher@1.0.0','builder'). Verified meaningful area at p01 t=2.4/3.0/3.8 (~0.05-0.07) and p13/p14 t=60.8/66.0 (~0.02-0.03).
diagnostic_hooks.doorState(times[]): -> { propId, sourceKey, usedRealDoorway, samples:[{t,grip,leaf,openAmount,doorwayRect,onCamera}] }. grip/leaf = scene.entityPoint('door.grip'|'door') world pos; openAmount = grip planar travel vs the t=0 closed baseline (reflects the REAL S4 hinged leaf); doorwayRect = projected door prop mesh bounds; usedRealDoorway = scene has a `doorway:*:opening` node and NO `doorway:*:fallback` node. Verified propId='door', sourceKey='door@1.1.0', usedRealDoorway=true, grip differs between p01 (t=2.4) and p13 (t=60.8) samples, doorway on camera at both.
diagnostic_hooks.jointSample(actorId,t): -> { actorId, present, root, joints{spine,neck,shoulder_l/r,elbow_l/r,hip_l/r,knee_l/r,head,hand_l/r,sole_l/r}, face{expression,blink,textureKey,mouthNarrationDriven} }. Poses scene at t then reads rig joint worldPos and parses the S3 face texture key. mouthNarrationDriven=false whenever the mouth token is closed/'-' (verified zapp key 'face:zapp@1.0.0:neutral:0:m=closed:a=0' -> false), proving the narrator VO never flaps a mouth (scene.ts FaceTrack has no mouth driver / no PhraseMouth from Beat.text).

findings.verification: npm run typecheck PASS. node --test tests/vignette-runtime-integration.test.ts PASS 5/5. Headless Chromium smoke (.scratch/vignette-full-smoke.mjs, gitignored): startServer + launchBrowser (chromium /opt/playwright), goto /apps/studio/blank.html, addScriptTag the built /dist/.../vignette-full-page.js, waitFor window.__s7v.ready, init(sheet,lib,runVignette(sheet,lib,{}).shots,540,960) OK, drew 5 frames out of order + deterministic same-t redraw, all three hooks returned real values, ZERO pageerrors (the only 404 was /favicon.ico).
findings.notes_for_FEAT-003: Built JS path: dist/packages/captions/src/preview/vignette-full-page.js. Node side must ensureHeadlessCanvas() before runVignette (headless canvas), and pass runVignette(...).shots to init. shotCuts()=beat boundaries (each beat is one shot). Nothing under v1 (packages/captions/full-render/) was touched.
